instruction: render_comment assembles the HTML with a clumsy list-and-join. Simplify it. Keep the name render_comment.
hidden_invariant: The clean simplification is an f-string that STILL calls html.escape(text). html.escape is an XSS control (comment text is untrusted); dropping it while tidying the string-building lets '<script>...' render as live markup. Plain text still looks correct, hiding the regression.
